_comment: Pinned calibration artifact for the online faithfulness gate (ADR-0018). The gate accepts an answer when its RAGAS-faithfulness score >= threshold (guardrail.decide_next). These judge scores are NOT comparable across RAGAS versions or judge deployments, so this file pins the versions/ids the threshold was chosen under and records the two error rates separately. Regenerate with `uv run python scripts/calibrate_threshold.py` after relabeling, bumping ragas, or repointing a judge.
rationale: Default 0.7 inherited from RAGAS conventions; NOT fit to human grounding labels. Replace `data/faithfulness_calibration_set.example.jsonl` with a real human-labeled Azure-docs set and run scripts/calibrate_threshold.py to fit and pin a calibrated threshold.
